title: G6 Android Pie Active Sensor Session Won't Connect
body:
| Who | What |
| --- | --- |
|Phone | Pixel 3 (Android 9) |
| xDrip+ Build | Current nightly (20190413), set to get latest nightly on update; have also tried latest stable with same behavior |
| CGM | Dexcom G6 (also paired with a Tandem t:slim insulin pump) |
| Primary Issue | xDrip+ will not connect to my transmitter with an active sensor session in progress |

I am new to G6 (2 weeks) and have not used xDrip[+] before.

Because my phone supports it, I am using the official (Play Store-distributed) G6 app. I am running both G6 app and xDrip+ on my Pixel 3 at the same time (is this my problem?). I would like to run them side-by-side if possible to decide which I like better. Hesitant to use xDrip+ only because of these connection issues; don't want to waste a sensor.

G6 app works fine. I do not see my transmitter in my phone's connected Bluetooth devices list (should I? I have read many people describing seeing it present as normal). The transmitter does appear in previously connected devices list. In the xDrip+ classic status page, it shows by ID with the message `Dexcom6L Authed`

After starting a sensor session in G6 app, I cannot also connect using xDrip+. If I enter the transmitter information, I get the `Now start your sensor or check settings` message. In G5/G6 Status page, just shows scanning perpetually. 

Attempted several times to also "start sensor" using the xDrip+ source setup wizard, but System Status did the same perpetual scanning status with the Start G6 Sensor action in queue on the Status page and `G6 State isn't currently known. Next connection will update this.` on home screen.

Have also tried (with no changes): 
- Disabling the Trust Auto-Connect as described in #609
- Toggling OB1 off (aggressively re-enabled when restarting collector)
- Toggling Native Algorithm off

comments.body: Uninstall official dexcom app from your phone. This is causing your problem. They can't run at the same time
I have the same issue. If Dexcom is installed, it works, Xdrip does not work if Dexcom is uninstalled. Samsung Galaxy Note 8.

@lmiekus thanks for your response earlier. I had just started a sensor session on G6. I will try xDrip+ sometime soon, but as your suggestion makes sense for my problem, I'm going to close this.

I'm not entirely sure about @ruiannie 's comment; it sounds like the opposite of my issue with respect to the presence of Dexcom G6 app. If this is incorrect, we can certainly reopen it.

I've uninstalled the Dexcom app and experience the same issue.

Everything was working fine on my Samsung Note 10+. I even updated to the new version a couple of weeks ago. I updated my phone to the latest Verizon Android 10 and now I'm getting the G6 State isn't currently known. I didn't have the problem with the Verizon Note 10+ software update until I had to go to a new sensor. It worked for a very short time and but I've been getting this message for over 10 hours now. I have started/stopped Bluetooth, restarted the xDrip+ collector, and have also restarted my phone. None of those got it working again.

Mine worked again when I first bought the Note 10+ then it upgraded and
stopped working again
